correctness.rationale: Conditional on the cited general q-Kronecker lower bound from Enomoto, the package's specialization is internally complete. For the staircase partition, the exact hook-product ratio gives logarithmic increment \((2+\log(q-1)-3\log2)n+O(1)\), summing to the displayed quadratic coefficient before division by composition length \((q+2)n\). The derivative test reduces to a strictly decreasing scalar function with positive value at q=3 and negative value at q=4; direct exact comparison gives c(4)>c(3), hence q=4 is the integer maximizer and c decreases thereafter. Fresh independent exact-ratio checks for 3<=q<=8, 2<=n<=10 and numerical coefficient checks through q=100 reproduced the arithmetic. The inaccessible primary theorem text is retained as a correctness-access residual risk rather than silently treated as independently read.
residual_risks: The exact general-q source theorem could not be line-by-line checked because the full primary body was unavailable after the permitted access attempts.
